notes.title: Summer 2025 Update
notes.content:
New Content:
Bottom string Bikini with 3 colour variations: pink, black and golden.

Top String Bikini with 3 colour variations: pink, black and golden.

Fixed broken main animations: clipping body parts, non-synchronized pounding, and such.

Fixed broken mini game animations: clipping body parts, non-synchronized pounding, and such.

Fixed hair rendering material: it was darker than in the trailer

Fixed missing localized button info popups

Fixed missing text translations such as the exit game confirmation message

Added a mini game window with instructions and the options of starting it or cancelling.

Added a time bar for the mini game.

notes.title: Graphics & Moanings Boost
notes.content:
Hr's the new changes for this update:

- Switched all of the skin materials to hand painted textured materials. These new materials have color variations like in real life skin, (the previous ones were just plain-colored), so now the skin has a more realistic touch.


https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/41794065/3da74f0ade2834d66719c7585df574ff989d3b26.png


- Added Korean language option,
- Added Simplified Chinese language option,

- Fixed volume panel scale.
- Removed scale effect from the Shop buttons, which was annoying.
- Removed scale effect from Character Customization sliders, since it made hard to click on the sliders handlers.

- Implemented voice and sex SFX ;D

- New bundle: now you'll be able to get both Lesbian Voyeur Simulator 2 and Slutty Sluts Panic at  20% regular price.

notes.title: Christmas Update
notes.content:
Here's the changes for this update:

- Implemented key binding configuration
- Removed annoying scale effect from sliders

- Added Christmas content:
    * Santa hat
    * Reindeer horns
    * Gingerbread nipples
    * Gift box nipples
    * Rudolph nose

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41794065/5b0224c7e8ae99d7fe76a8e5ad7e4ccc9b1210ae.png

    * Forest small waterfall during daytime

If you have more suggestions about content you'd like to see, let me know.

I hope you guys have a happy Christmas and a happy new year.
Cheers
